title: VERITAS run result
description: One result record produced by running a single candidate tool against a single firmware image

schema_version.description: Version of this schema, incremented when fields change

tool_version.description: Git commit hash or version string of the tool at time of run

run_id.description: Unique identifier for this run, format: YYYYMMDD_HHMMSSz__tool__short_hash

run_timestamp_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the run started

architecture.description: Architecture passed to the tool, e.g. arm, mips, x86

firmware_sha256.description: SHA256 of the firmware image, for cross-referencing with corpus manifest

unpack.description: Independent extraction baseline measured by VERITAS before the tool runs

veritas_rootfs_found.description: Whether VERITAS independently found a root filesystem using Binwalk

veritas_fs_types.description: Filesystem types VERITAS detected, e.g. [squashfs, jffs2]

veritas_elf_count.description: Number of ELF binaries found in the extracted filesystem

tool_claimed_unpack.description: Whether the tool reported successful extraction in its output. Null if the tool does not report this.

boot.description: Boot outcome measured by monitoring the tool process

success.description: True if the tool reported a stable running state before timeout

wall_time_seconds.description: Total elapsed time from tool start to boot signal or timeout

cpu_seconds.description: Cumulative CPU time consumed across all child processes

peak_ram_mb.description: Peak RSS memory in megabytes across all child processes

timeout_seconds.description: The timeout budget used for this run

timed_out.description: True if the run hit the timeout without producing a boot signal

failure_reason.description: Brief reason if boot failed, e.g. kernel_panic, nvram_missing, extraction_failed

service.description: Network service probe results measured independently by VERITAS

reported_ip.description: IP address the tool reported as the firmware network address

reported_port.description: Port the tool reported as the service port

tcp_connect.description: Whether a TCP connection succeeded to the reported IP and port

http_status.description: HTTP status code returned, or null if TCP connect failed

body_size_bytes.description: Size of the HTTP response body in bytes

body_sha256.description: SHA256 of the response body, for detecting repeated false positives

service_reachable.description: True if TCP connect succeeded and HTTP returned any response

service_authentic.description: True if the response does not match known host default pages

false_positive_reason.description: If service_authentic is false, the matched signature, e.g. apache2_ubuntu_default

stability.description: Re-probe 60 seconds after tool declares success

probe_attempted.description: Whether the stability probe ran. False if initial service was not reachable.

service_reachable_at_60s.description: Whether the service was still reachable 60 seconds after initial success

service_authentic_at_60s.description: Whether the service was still authentic at the 60-second probe

stale_tap_devices.description: Names of TAP network interfaces still present after the tool exited

orphan_qemu_pids.description: PIDs of QEMU processes still running after the tool exited

orphan_docker_containers.description: Docker container IDs still running after the tool exited

cleanup_clean.description: True if all three stale lists are empty

logs.description: Paths to raw tool output logs

stdout_path.description: Relative path to the captured stdout log

stderr_path.description: Relative path to the captured stderr log

notes.description: Free-text observations added during the run, e.g. unexpected warnings
